# bob areas

Inspect or maintain area notes

```text title="bob areas --help"
Inspect or maintain area notes

Bare `bob areas` runs the read-only list. `list` shows the colored area tree with hues, titles, summaries, and project/Today chips. `check` lints areas against the contract and reports catalog state. `sync` repairs every generated `## Areas` catalog (`-d` previews diffs) in one guarded commit.

Usage: bob areas [COMMAND]

Commands:
  check  Check areas against the contract
  list   List the area tree (default)
  sync   Write every generated area catalog

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob areas` runs the read-only list.

Examples:
  bob areas                       List the colored area tree
  bob areas list -f json          Area tree as JSON
  bob areas check                 Lint areas against the contract
  bob areas check -f json         Findings as JSON
  bob areas sync -d               Preview catalog changes as diffs
  bob areas sync                  Write every generated catalog

See docs/areas.md for the area catalog contract.
Run 'bob areas <command> --help' for more information on a command.
```

## bob areas check

Check areas against the contract

```text title="bob areas check --help"
Findings grouped by path, plus an area/error/warning summary. Exits 1 on any error finding (including a damaged catalog), 0 when the vault is clean or warning-only. This command is read-only.

Usage: bob areas check [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob areas check
  bob areas check -f json

See docs/areas.md for the area catalog contract.
```

## bob areas list

List the area tree (default)

```text title="bob areas list --help"
Colored area tree with hues, optional titles and summaries, and project/Today chips. This command is read-only and always exits 0. Bare `bob areas` runs this command.

Usage: bob areas list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob areas
  bob areas list
  bob areas list -f json

See docs/areas.md for the area catalog contract.
```

## bob areas sync

Write every generated area catalog

```text title="bob areas sync --help"
Repair the generated `## Areas` catalog in the root and in every area with sub-areas. A real run takes the shared vault lock, pre-syncs, rewrites only the bytes between each catalog's markers, and makes one scoped commit `areas: sync catalogs (N notes)`; a vault whose catalogs are current writes and commits nothing. `--dry-run` prints a unified diff per host and changes nothing. A damaged catalog (a malformed opener) is skipped and reported, while healthy hosts still apply, and the command exits 1.

Usage: bob areas sync [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -d, --dry-run
          Print what would change as unified diffs; write nothing

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob areas sync
  bob areas sync -d
  bob areas sync -f json

See docs/areas.md for the area catalog contract.
```
